verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a bulk-action capability, such as bulk-assigning, bulk-updating or bulk-approving many controls, tasks, vendors or access-review items at once. The cited features (task assignment, AI system management, findings, webhooks for ingestion) are all per-item or adjacent workflows, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
